description: This PHP file defines a class 'FormatWithFluency' which implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface. The class provides a method to format an entity value into a fluency string for EmployeeLanguage entities, specifically fetching the fluency description from a static array.

classes.name: FormatWithFluency
classes.description: A class that formats an employee language entity value into a fluency string using a predefined static array.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the fluency string corresponding to the given entity value from the EmployeeLanguage FLUENCIES array, or null if not found.
